scope: Fresh build, log, PDF-text and first-page checks for a title-only revision. Inherited source lint and citation checks are explicitly separated. No experiments rerun.
title: The Review–Execution Gap in Agentic Software: Approval Scope and Recovery

fresh_checks.main_stabilization: One additional pdflatex pass after the standard three-pass build cleared the rerun-label notice. Final warnings are zero.
fresh_checks.text_comparison_method: pdftotext -layout; Unicode NFKC ligature normalization; remove soft hyphens; join word-boundary hyphen plus newline wraps; collapse all whitespace; replace Approval Binding and Recovery by Approval Scope and Recovery in v7 text. No other tokens replaced.

first_page_visual_review.method: Rendered each PDF first page with pdftoppm at 110 dpi and inspected the rendered image. Final main first-page raster is identical to the inspected pre-stabilization raster.
first_page_visual_review.main.pdf: Title occupies two balanced lines; authors, affiliation, email, abstract and keyword blocks are readable with no overlap or clipping.
first_page_visual_review.Online-Resource-1.pdf: Resource heading and single-line manuscript title fit within margins; author/contact block and following text are clear.
first_page_visual_review.Online-Resource-2.pdf: Resource heading and single-line manuscript title fit within margins; title, author and affiliation blocks have clear separation.

inherited_checks_from_v7.basis: All 12 TeX files were compared byte-for-byte; only the full/short title phrase replacements in three files differ. Bibliography is byte-identical.

latexindent.reason: Executable installed but cannot find required Perl runtime; not treated as a source failure
